name: patient_is_undergoing_endoscopic_ultrasonography_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently undergoing endoscopic ultrasonography.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing endoscopic ultrasonography.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently undergoing endoscopic ultrasonography.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently undergoing endoscopic ultrasonography.
